findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_scrape, styx_fetch, o_hnsearch, o_ioc_reputation, o_paste_email, o_sitemap, fc_scrape · Private data: hash, lynx_inspect, o_api_key_scan, o_bimi, o_breachdirectory, o_circlhash, o_credential_stuffing, o_cvedetail, o_dns, o_dnsmx, o_dnsprop, o_dnsquery, o_dnsrecon, o_dnsverify, o_doh, o_exploit_cve, o_gh_secret_scan, o_hibp, o_ipv4classify, o_ipwhois, o_leaklookup, o_mimetype, o_nvdcve, o_passgen, o_password_dumps, o_phonespam, o_phonevcard, o_rdap, o_rdapip, o_reversedns, o_securitytxt, o_snusbase_hash, o_srvlookup, o_tlsa, o_trufflehog_url, o_wayback_leaks, o_zenodo, re_search, re_semantic · Public sink: http_client, o_abusecontact, o_email, o_emailrep, o_formaudit, o_hibp_email, o_intelx_email, o_ip_math, o_medium, o_paste_email · Destructive: execute_js, math, cron, titan_generate, v_json_format, o_latlonformat.
